Shortest path attains minimum even in infinite W because positive edge minimum and only finitely many cost sums <=b. Possible positive distances r,2r,...,kr,b with exact strict thresholds; path on k+2 vertices with B=A^k forces distances in disjoint open intervals ((i-1)a,ia) for i=1..k and terminal >=b. For k=1 a 3-point nested A,B witness forces three levels. Independent path witness k=2..9 recomputed.
